name: ai.vhoo/vhoo
title: Vhoo.ai
description: AI image & video generation (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Seedream 5.5) and viral template discovery.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all Vhoo.ai AI image and video models with supported resolutions, aspect ratios, durations, reference limits, and base credit costs. No API key required.

kind.description: Filter models by media kind. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: estimate_credits
tools.description: Calculate the exact credit cost for a basic Vhoo.ai image or video generation before running it. No API key required.

kind.description: Whether to estimate an image or video generation.

resolution.description: Output resolution supported by the model (e.g. "1k", "2k" for images; "480p", "720p", "1080p" for videos).

duration.description: Video duration in seconds (required when kind is "video").

quality.description: Image quality level for GPT Image 2.6 SVG output.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search and browse published viral AI video and image templates on Vhoo.ai. Returns preview links and official web URLs — templates cannot be generated via MCP and must be opened on the Vhoo.ai website to remix. No API key required.

query.description: Optional keyword to match template names or URL slugs (e.g. "zombie", "broom", "hotel", "smiths").

limit.description: Maximum results per page (1-24). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_template_details
tools.description: Get details, description, preview media, and the direct Vhoo.ai website URL for a published template by slug. Templates are read-only in MCP and must be used on vhoo.ai. No API key required.

tools.name: list_studio_tools
tools.description: List specialized Vhoo.ai browser tools (Roblox Video AI, Minecraft Skin Generator, AI GIF Generator, AI Image Layer Splitter, AI Real Estate Video, Motion Control, Video Editing) with direct website URLs. No API key required.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Retrieve current Vhoo.ai subscription tiers, one-time non-expiring credit packs, and concurrency limits. No API key required.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Check the authenticated user account available credit balance (total, expiring, and non-expiring credits). Requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer vhoo_...).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Submit a basic text-to-image or image-to-image generation task using Vhoo.ai models (Seedream 5.5, GPT Image 2.6, FLUX 3, Nano Banana). Deducts account credits and returns a taskId to poll with get_generation_status. Requires an API key.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate or edit.

model.description: Image model to use. Defaults to "seedream-5-5". Call list_models to inspect capabilities.

resolution.description: Output resolution supported by the chosen model. Defaults to "1k".

quality.description: Quality level (used by GPT Image 2.6). Defaults to "medium".

transparent.description: Request transparent PNG background (Seedream 5.5 PNG only).

imageUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS reference image URLs for image-to-image editing.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Submit a basic text-to-video or image-to-video generation task using Vhoo.ai models (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, MiniMax H3, Muse Video, Gemini Omni). Does not run viral templates (templates must be used on vhoo.ai). Deducts account credits and returns a taskId to poll with get_generation_status. Requires an API key.

prompt.description: Text description of the scene, subject motion, and camera movement.

model.description: Video model to use. Defaults to "seedance-2.0-fast". Call list_models to inspect supported resolutions and durations.

resolution.description: Video resolution supported by the chosen model (e.g. "480p", "720p", "1080p").

duration.description: Video duration in seconds supported by the chosen model.

generateAudio.description: Generate native synchronized audio when supported. Defaults to true.

imageUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS reference image URLs for image-to-video (supported on Seedance, Kling 4.0, MiniMax H3, and Gemini Omni).

firstFrameUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS opening frame image URL (cannot be combined with imageUrls).

lastFrameUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS closing frame image URL (requires firstFrameUrl; cannot be combined with imageUrls).

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Poll the live status, progress, and final media URLs for an image or video generation task created on your Vhoo.ai account. Requires an API key.

kind.description: Whether the task is an image or video generation.

taskId.description: The taskId returned by generate_image or generate_video.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: List recent standalone AI image and video generation tasks on the authenticated Vhoo.ai account. Requires an API key.

kind.description: Filter by generation kind. Defaults to "all".

limit.description: Maximum items per kind (1-20). Defaults to 10.
